cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
def run(cmds):
    out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/main.py"],input="\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cmds)+"\n",capture_output=True,text=True)
    return [json.loads(x) for x in out.stdout.splitlines()]
L={"op":"load","n":4,"links":[[0,1,10],[1,2,10],[2,3,10],[0,3,10]],"bookings":[]}
P=lambda id,owner,rev,part=[[0,1],[2,1]],env=[[0,1],[1,1],[2,1],[3,1]],win=[0,20],per=10: {"op":"prepare","id":id,"owner":owner,"window":win,"period":per,"participants":part,"envelope":env,"rev":rev}
# owner is part of identity
reps=run([L, P("x","o1",0), P("x","o2",0), P("x","o1",0)])
print("owner identity:", [r.get('status') for r in reps[1:]])
# window in identity
reps=run([L, P("x","o1",0), P("x","o1",0,win=[0,30]), P("x","o1",0)])
print("window identity:", [r.get('status') for r in reps[1:]])
# period in identity
reps=run([L, P("x","o1",0), P("x","o1",0,per=5), P("x","o1",0)])
print("period identity:", [r.get('status') for r in reps[1:]])
# participants ordering ignored, multiset identity
reps=run([L, P("x","o1",0,part=[[2,1],[0,1]]), P("x","o1",0,part=[[0,1],[2,1]]), P("x","o1",0,part=[[0,2],[2,1]])])
print("participant identity:", [r.get('status') for r in reps[1:]])
# envelope ordering ignored
reps=run([L, P("x","o1",0,env=[[3,1],[2,1],[1,1],[0,1]]), P("x","o1",0,env=[[0,1],[1,1],[2,1],[3,1]])])
print("envelope identity:", [r.get('status') for r in reps[1:]])
# expired lease cannot be resurrected; commit of expired -> GONE
reps=run([L, P("x","o1",0), {"op":"commit","id":"x","owner":"o1","rev":0},
          {"op":"advance","time":20}, {"op":"commit","id":"x","owner":"o1","rev":1},
          {"op":"cancel","id":"x","owner":"o1","rev":1}, {"op":"audit","at":[20]}])
print("expiry:", [ (r.get('status'), r.get('code') or r.get('expired') or r.get('replay')) for r in reps[2:]])
# prepare with window starting exactly at now is fine; s<now -> TIME
reps=run([L, P("x","o1",0,win=[0,20]), {"op":"advance","time":5},
          P("y","o1",1,win=[5,25]), P("y","o1",1,win=[4,25])])
print("time boundary:", [ (r.get('status'), r.get('kind') or r.get('code')) for r in reps[2:]])
PYEOF
